pool.text: A young Mexican scout named Rafael Rivera encountered the valley first.
Land was auctioned near railroad tracks to found the city.
Hotel Nevada opened as the oldest continuously operating casino today.
The settlement was officially incorporated as a city.
The city installed a welcome arch over Fremont Street.
The Northern Club opened its doors in the downtown area.
The Las Vegas Army Airfield was established late in the year.
Nuclear weapons testing began at the nearby Nevada Test Site.
The Moulin Rouge Hotel opened as an integrated casino.
The Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas sign was installed.
The Mirage opened and started a trend of major resorts.
The Review-Journal installed the largest newspaper printing press.
A replica welcome sign was installed within city limits.
Mayor Oscar Goodman announced plans for Symphony Park.
The World Market Center opened with three large buildings.
The Sun was awarded a Pulitzer Prize for Public Service.
The RTC launched the Strip & Downtown Express bus service.
City offices moved to a new Las Vegas City Hall.
Circa Resort & Casino opened on Fremont Street.
High-speed rail project Brightline West began construction.
